newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks quiet after a day's surge.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks quiet after a day's surge.

text.p: Stocks remained quiet in trading after the close, which saw them surge and push Dow industrials above 7000 for the first time in nearly seven weeks, traders said Wednesday.
"There is nothing going on here," said one dealer.
Another said the few stocks that were trading were not moving more than a 1/16 or an 1/8 from their closing price.
The New York Stock Exchange said Wednesday session one had a volume of 25,500 shares against 30,100 the previous day, while session two had 6.7 million against 3.6 million.
